note: MESSAGES.md 7.2 / 10.2: one allow file per src module. literals: {text: {category, reason}}; raises: G1e English raise texts that are never shown; composed: G1f; sinks: G5.

the history job was never written.reason: require_job's LookupError: caught by the history writer and logged to download.log only (MESSAGES.md 7.2 G1e)

no options.reason: resume_options' ValueError: caught at the caller, which shows a fixed t() dialog instead (MESSAGES.md 7.2 G1e)

messages.show(error)[:130].reason: the note text is shown with messages.show and then cut to 130 characters for the one-line note, the 1.7.0 cut of the shown text (zh: the same bytes as 1.7.0); a slice of shown text is display text

history_status(row).reason: the status cell of a history row (checked cell by cell, MESSAGES.md 15 A11.4): history_status returns i18n.t / i18n.label of a known status, or the stored status id itself when 1.8.0 does not know it (a status written by a later version), shown as it is, as in 1.7.0; the id is never an app text

total.reason: a number, not a text: Library.history_count() or len(jobs) (an int) for show_history_count

written.reason: a number, not a text: HistoryWriter.written, the int count of writes done after a wait

name.reason: the subscription name the owner typed (or the first start link cut to 65 characters, user data); shown as typed in the two log lines of save_subscription, as in 1.7.0

row['pending'].reason: a number, not a text: the int count of pending entries Library.subscriptions() computes (the fourth cell of subscription_row, checked cell by cell since A11.4)
